title: Project
description: Represents a personal, academic, professional, or collaborative project.

name.title: Project Name
name.description: The name or title of the project.

url.title: Project URL
url.description: The URI of the project's website, repository, demo, or primary online resource. Null indicates that no project URL is available.

description.title: Project Description
description.description: A summary of the project's purpose, functionality, scope, or significance.

image.title: Project Image
image.description: The path or URI of an image representing the project. Null indicates that no project image is available.

imageAlt.title: Project Image Alternative Text
imageAlt.description: Alternative text describing the project image for accessibility. Null indicates that no alternative text is available.

date.title: Project Date
date.description: The year, month, or date associated with the project.

dateLabel.title: Project Date Label
dateLabel.description: The display format of the year, month, or date associated with the project.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.description: A list of notable achievements, outcomes, contributions, or results associated with the project.

items.description: A notable achievement, outcome, contribution, or result.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: A list of technologies, concepts, categories, or keywords associated with the project.

items.description: A technology, concept, category, or keyword associated with the project.

links.title: Related Links
links.description: A list of labeled links related to the project.

collaborators.title: Collaborators
collaborators.description: A list of people or organizations that contributed to the project.

name.title: Collaborator Name
name.description: The name of the collaborating person or organization.

url.title: Collaborator URL
url.description: The URI of the collaborator's website, profile, or relevant online resource.
